description: This file is a C source file implementing platform-dependent utility functions for the Psm File Loader Object within the CCSP framework. It mainly contains the implementation of the PsmCreateFileLoader function, which creates and returns a new file loader object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmCreateFileLoader(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Psm File Loader Object, taking in container, owner, and reserved context handles.
